caption: The drawing is rendered in black ink on a beige background and depicts three views of a wooden side chair: a front elevation, a side elevation, and a partial top view in the upper left. The front elevation shows a chair with an intricately carved top rail featuring scrolled ornamentation, a tall, straight rectangular back, and a lower section with turned legs and stretchers. A hatched area in the upper section of the backrest represents a panel or material inset. The lower front rail is shaped with a decorative curve, and the feet of the chair appear to be block-shaped. The side elevation reveals the backward slope of the backrest, straight front legs, and back legs that angle rearward. The stretchers on the side are thinner and turned, matching those in the front. The top view in the upper left shows the rectangular shape of the chair's seat and a hatched section to indicate a different material or construction detail. In the upper right corner, faint text reads "SIDE CHAIR LATE 17th or EARLY 18th CENT., SCALE ¾” = 1’." All objects are drawn with clean, precise lines and no color other than the black ink used for outlines and hatching.
title: Side Chair
